mainEntity.name: What is involved in converting a garage into a living space?

acceptedAnswer.text: A garage conversion turns an attached or detached garage into fully finished, conditioned living space, such as an in-law suite, extra bedroom, home office, or family room. Because the garage slab, exterior framing, and roof are already in place, it eliminates the need to pour a new foundation from scratch. However, the space requires extensive modifications to make it comfortable and habitable. These updates typically include framing and insulating walls, adding drywall, leveling the concrete floor, extending electrical wiring, modifying or replacing the garage door opening, and adding dedicated heating and cooling.
acceptedAnswer.description: A garage conversion transforms an existing vehicle bay into a finished room by adding insulation, drywall, flooring, electrical upgrades, and dedicated climate control.
